The Mercenary Recruit is a hired Seeker who was swiftly recruited by DeFoe to join the Organization.
== History ==
The Mercenary Recruit was paid into the Organization by DeFoe who welcomed him into the group but warned him not to cash his paycheck till the end of the month. [TCG:OAL-056]

== Abilities ==
Like his name states, the Mercenary Recruit is just a hired hand whose abilities are average at best. He is also known to charge a refund fee.
=== Bonded Titans ===
*Unnamed Swara-Titan
